_comment: 战斗演出 B (DECISIONS「战斗演出 B」): the stage a fight is fought on — the stepped base of bricks laid under the fighters, its look by mode, and the camera's opening move. Presentation only: nothing here touches a rule, a position or a saved value. Timings are pacing.json's feel (arena_*, opening_*).

arena._comment: brick: a brick's side in voxel units (a 16 px cell of the 2D map); tiers: how many steps (small rooms: small_tiers); tier_height: each step's thickness; margin: bricks of top beyond the fighters each way; max_cells: the top at most this many bricks across and deep (beyond it, centred on the player); jitter: the share of each step's edge bricks dropped or added (the base reads laid by hand); lift_seconds: the fighters step up onto the top.

looks._comment: By the fight's mode (spar, lethal, lesson; a story fight takes lethal). tiers: bottom to top, each a few colours the bricks pick from; rim: the top step's edge; corners: what stands at the base's four corners (flag / brazier / none); rubble: loose stones scattered round the foot; sounds: a row laid, the stage done.

camera._comment: The opening move: the view's height over the fighters (the pitch: 41° is the map's own, atan(height / 30)); small rooms (fewer free cells than small_cells) pitch less; zoom: the push-in at most, for a duel (1 the map's; smaller is nearer), crowd_zoom the farthest it stays back to frame a crowd; band: the share of the screen's height the fighters stand in, under the cards and over the panel (the controller passes the real band when it has laid out).
